product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Bellatier Mid-Century Modern 34" Adjustable Height Curved Bar Stool, Brown & Black
features: UPHOLSTERED SWIVEL BAR STOOL: Rise to the occasion with this bar stool; it's an excellent complement to an eat-in kitchen or bar. Revel in the metal foot rest, which keeps you grounded
HANDSOMELY CRAFTED: Cushioned seat is upholstered with faux leather. Adorned with a weighted matte black metal base with adjustable counter to pub height seating for added convenience
CONTEMPORARY STYLE: 360 degree swivel accentuates the contoured back for optimum dining comfort. Bold black seats have sleek tailoring and a faux wood finish to tie together the ultra-modern visage

ADDED TABLE SEATING: Place a pair of these barstool chairs by a high table to accommodate guests. Barstool chair measures 19.88” W x 18” D x 48” H. Chair height ranges from 24.5-33.5". Adjustable seat height (max): 34.00 inch, (min): 26.00 inch, Adjustable footrest height (max): 16.50 inch, (min): 8.50 inch, Adjustable Height (min): 40.00 inch, (max): 48.00 inch
ASSEMBLY REQUIRED: Easy-to-follow instructions, tools and hardware included. Includes 1 bar stool. Estimated Assembly Time: 15 Minutes
description: Style takes quite a modern turn. Sporting a distinctively contoured back and seat design, this upholstered swivel bar stool is sure to bring an elevated look to your living space. Wrapped in a brown faux leather upholstery, the seating area’s artful contours are accentuated with a faux wood finish. From the minimalist to the brash, we offer bar stools in a range of styles so you can always find the perfect piece for your space.
